$comment: Diagnostic probes from Value Proposition Design (mapping §3). For the interview phase that touches on the offer/proposal.

probes.text: For your segment — who exactly are they, and what problem do they want to solve?

signal_interpretation.positive: Satu segmen spesifik + masalah jelas — prasyarat value proposition terpenuhi
signal_interpretation.negative: Blurry segment / mixed many customer types — ICP dilution, profile cannot be created

probes.text: If your customers explain the problem themselves, what are their words — not yours?

signal_interpretation.positive: There is concrete voice-of-customer (their quotes/terms) — value framing can use that language.
signal_interpretation.negative: Hanya jargon penjual / tidak pernah dengar kata mereka — framing pasti off-target

probes.text: State their most extreme pain — in the units they use themselves (minutes, rupiah, percent)?

signal_interpretation.positive: There is a measurable threshold ('more than x minutes', 'around Rp y') — pain concretization, testable
signal_interpretation.negative: Pain is described vaguely without measurement — severity cannot be validated

probes.text: Offer Anda menyelesaikan pain/gain mana SATU yang paling penting — dan seberapa baik dibanding alternatif mereka saat ini?

signal_interpretation.positive: Satu fokus jelas + tahu keunggulan vs alternatif — karakteristik #2, #3, #9 terpenuhi arah
signal_interpretation.negative: Mau menyelesaikan semuanya / tidak tahu posisi vs alternatif — offer tidak fokus, tidak diferensial

probes.text: Try to state your offer in one sentence: we help [who] who want [what] with [how], different from [competitors]?

signal_interpretation.positive: Ad-lib terisi penuh dan koheren — capability sudah menjadi offer
signal_interpretation.negative: Gagal mengisi / kalimat tidak utuh — capability-offer disconnect terkonfirmasi
signal_interpretation.neutral: Filled in but segment or differentiation empty — half-finished offer

probes.text: Of the 10 characteristics of a good value proposition, which 3 are the weakest in your offer?

signal_interpretation.positive: Honest self-assessment with specific weak areas — the starting point for improvement is identified.
signal_interpretation.negative: Mengklaim semua kuat tanpa bukti — overconfidence, tidak ada basis assessment

probes.text: Fit tahap mana Anda: punya bukti customer peduli (paper), peduli ke offer Anda (market), atau model untung (bank)?

signal_interpretation.positive: Know exactly its stage — the next path can be determined (problem-solution → product-market → business model)
signal_interpretation.negative: Tidak tahu / campur aduk — jalur tidak terdefinisi, langkah apa pun prematur

probes.text: The riskiest hypothesis of your offer — what must be true for this to work — and what is the cheapest experiment that proves it?

signal_interpretation.positive: Hipotesis kritis teridentifikasi + eksperimen termurah jelas (test card) — jalur bukti ada
signal_interpretation.negative: No explicit hypothesis / want to go straight to building the whole thing — spreadsheet fantasy, there won't be any evidence

probes.text: The last conversation or experiment that changed your decision about the offer — what was the result?

signal_interpretation.positive: There was a real experiment that changed the decision — evidence-driven, weight increased.
signal_interpretation.negative: Keputusan murni dari opini/debat internal tanpa lapangan — opinion dominates over facts

probes.text: How does the customer measure success for that job — what numbers do they use?

signal_interpretation.positive: Success criteria customer diketahui dan offer selaras dengannya — karakteristik #6
signal_interpretation.negative: Don't know how they measure success — the value framing won't align.
